description_en: Update the protocols of images to Adaptive Streaming Protocol (ASP)
description_zh: 将镜像的协议升级为ASP协议
kebab_example: aliyun ecd migrate-image-protocol --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --target-protocol-type ASP --image-id m-gqudcafrqcex90000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateImageProtocol

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The protocol to which you want to update the image protocols. Set the value to ASP
parameters.help_zh: 目标镜像协议，当前仅支持填入ASP
parameters.name: target_protocol_type
